messages:
maria: Quick sync — customer pilot feedback for the Optimize alpha rolled in. We need to decide must-haves vs nice-to-haves for launch.
aj: Can you paste the top asks? I skimmed but want specifics.
maria: Top asks: 1) per-route batching suggestions (auto/override) 2) cache TTL recommendations per model+route 3) quantization profile suggestions for fp16->int8 safe defaults 4) eval-triggered alerts when quality regresses.
syed: +1 on eval alerts — customers care about silent regressions. Need to define what triggers them.
kate: From CS: two pilot customers asked for an opt-out per-route for caching (legal/data reasons). Also they want simple UI toggles.
dylan: For eval triggers we should define metric buckets: nll delta, top-k accuracy, and hallucination rate per prompt set. Thresholds need to be configurable.
aj: Engineering concern: per-route recommendations mean we need per-route telemetry and a scoring job. That's a nontrivial infra weight. How much of that do we include in alpha?
maria: Proposal: Alpha = automated recommendations engine + UI that surfaces them, but recommendations are advisory only (no auto-apply). Must support per-route opt-out and exportable CSV.
syed: Implementation idea: offline batch job that scores routes daily and writes recommendations to a small DB. No streaming needed for alpha.
aj: That keeps infra scope sane. What about quantization recommendations — do we produce a single suggestion like "try int8-4" or a profile with expected latency/cost delta and a risk score?
dylan: Risk score is important. We can run a small eval harness on shadowed requests (sampled) and estimate generation divergence. Output: {profile, expected%latency, expected%cost, risk_score}.
kate: Customer ask — show example prompts that fail/regress so they can triage.
maria: Launch criteria brainstorm: 1) Recommendations available for >=3 pilot customers and >=50 routes each; 2) UI surfaces rec + rationale and sample failing prompts; 3) Eval-alert basics: single-team threshold + email/console alerting; 4) Docs + quickstart.
aj: Dev constraints: need RBAC for who can view vs apply; but since alpha is advisory, apply is manual via console + runbook. RBAC MVP: product role read, ops role apply.
syed: Can we reuse existing eval infra? We have eval harness in eng-ml but need to add per-route hook and storage for sampled prompts.
maria: Action items: @aj scope infra changes and estimate (ETA next Wed), @dylan define eval metrics + thresholds proposal (ETA Tue), @syed sketch data flow for sampled prompts and storage + opt-out controls (ETA Tue), @kate coordinate pilot comms and legal opt-out checklist (ETA Fri).
aj: Noted. One more ask: per-route batching suggestions should include target batch size and expected latency impact. That needs a simple model but doable.
dylan: I'll prototype a heuristic: observe 95th pctl latency vs batch size curve from traces, suggest B where incremental cost/latency tradeoff is acceptable.
kate: Pilot customers asked about SLA for recommendations — they want a guarantee that recommendations won't be auto-applied. Call that out in docs.
maria: Agreed. Also decide on alert delivery: console + email for alpha. Pager only for severe production regressions (not in alpha).
deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule a cross-functional sync after estimates are in — use #product-calendar to book.
maria: Last note: keep UX minimal — list of recs per route, expand to show evidence, and CSV export. Keep rollout plan: start advisory for pilots, then add optional auto-apply with feature flags in Dedicated later.
aj: OK will start sizing. Thanks all.
kate: I'll draft pilot email + FAQ after I get the scope doc.
maria: Closing — will consolidate into a short PRD and link here when ready.
